messages:
zoe (People Ops): hey all 1 thanks for joining the Q&A thread after todays all-hands. drop follow-ups here about calibration, appeals, comp, equity timing, and benefits changes. quick note: calibration window closes Friday 11:59pm PT.

rashid (SWE): two quick Qs: 1) can an IC file an appeal without manager buy-in? 2) any guidance on documenting cross-team impact?

mike (Head of People): 1) appeals should come with manager acknowledgement; if manager is the issue, escalate to your people partner and well accept a direct IC submission with evidence.

zoe (People Ops): 2) cross-team impact: cite measurable outcomes, names of collaborators, and time period (e.g., led cross-org reliability work for Q1-Q3 that removed a 2x incident rate). short bullets work best.

tara (Eng Manager): manager question: missed calibration window  can we submit a late case?

zoe (People Ops): yes for documented emergencies. use the Late Calibration Exception form and cc your people partner. we triage within 48 hours.

nina (Total Rewards): equity timing: next RSU grant window is on schedule. for promos approved after the grant window theres a mid-cycle grant process  submit via the Grants request and mark as "promo mid-cycle". timelines vary by region.

rashid (SWE): payroll timing for retro pay? last cycle took a while for EMEA hires. any changes?

benefits-bot: Payroll note: EMEA cutoff is earlier. expect 2 payroll cycles for retro; 3 if tax reconciliation required. Submit payroll tickets ASAP.

tara (Eng Manager): compression situation  new hire above existing senior  what to do?

zoe (People Ops): common fixes: market-adjust, spot-adjust, or consider an internal promotion if merited. always loop People Ops early.

mike (Head of People): action items: 1) publish Calibration FAQ by Thu EOD (zoe) 2) post Appeals checklist and forms links (zoe) 3) update payroll KB with EMEA cutoff reminder (payroll team).

zoe (People Ops): thanks team  ill post the FAQ links here when live. office hours Fri 10-11am PT if you want to walk through cases. closing thread but open tickets and DMs welcome. :sparkles:
